messages:
Ella: post-GA short sync: we need a clear rule-set for next two sprints about bugs vs small wins. Quick thoughts?
Nate: propose hard gate: 72h of stable telemetry (p99 latency + error budget) before any enhancement goes to prod.
Maria: agreed on the gate. Also: customer requests that impact revenue (>=2 paying customers) can be escalated.
Sam: define small win: <=3 story points, no infra/runtime changes, no model changes. If it touches runtime or batching its an immediate mini-epic.
Oliver: UI-only fixes that are low risk can be slotted into the sprint if theyre owner-assigned and have a rollback plan.
cs-bot: flagged 2 customer requests matching description "search ordering tweak"
Ella: if CS flags >=2 matches for same tweak, product will do a 24h triage and scope a 1-day fix if ROI checks out.
Nate: hotfix rule: if fix <1 dev-day and impacts SLAs or revenue, do hotfix. Anything larger -> mini-epic with eng+design QA.
Maria: I'll publish the post-GA playbook page with these rules and the checklist (telemetry window, rollback, canary duration).
Sam: action items: Sam to update grooming template, Oliver to own rollback runbook, Ella to coordinate CS notices.
Ella: ok team — freeze on non-essential enhancements until telemetry gate passes. Revisit in grooming on Monday.
_meta: post-GA lane rules doc: freeze enhancements until 72h telemetry; define small-win criteria; CS escalation for >=2 paying customers; hotfix thresholds and ownership
